name: Insight
description: Decision-input integrity for onchain AI agents: before a trade, borrow, or perp order is signed, check whether the price and action it relies on are trustworthy. Cross-oracle consensus (13 providers, 40+ chains) with manipulation-risk verdicts and verifiable EIP-712 attestations, plus pre-signing guard families for Base, Monad, multichain EVM, Solana lending, Base and Hyperliquid perps, a Base swap guard, 24h Oracle Watch monitored windows, and Position Lifecycle bundles. Pay-per-call via x402 v2 in USDC.
